name: Gemini API free tier
what: Gemini models through the API, free of charge with rate limits. Enough for prototypes and side projects.

name: Groq free plan
what: Very fast open models on a free plan, with per-minute and daily limits for each model.

name: OpenRouter free models
what: Models whose id ends in :free cost nothing: 50 requests a day, or 1,000 a day once you have bought $10 of credit.

name: Workers AI
what: Open models on Cloudflare's network, with 10,000 neurons a day free. No API key needed inside a Worker.

name: Ollama
what: Run open models on your own machine, privately. Open source, so there's no API bill at all.

name: Hugging Face Hub
what: A free account gets you open models and datasets to download, and free static Spaces for demo pages.

name: Cloudflare Workers & Pages
what: A free plan for sites and serverless APIs. This site and its agent run on it.

name: LiveKit Cloud Build plan
what: Realtime voice and video agents: 1,000 agent minutes a month at $0, no credit card.

name: Supabase free plan
what: Postgres, auth and storage on a free plan, with pgvector for storing embeddings.

name: Qdrant Cloud free cluster
what: A managed vector database for RAG, free at a small size.

name: Neon free plan
what: Serverless Postgres on a free plan, with branching for safe experiments.

name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
what: The big one for students: free access to dozens of developer tools, GitHub Copilot included.

name: JetBrains for students
what: PyCharm and the other JetBrains IDEs, free while you study.

name: Azure for Students
what: Azure credit and free services for full-time university students. No credit card required.

name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
what: Google Cloud credits for startups: up to $350,000 on the AI track.

name: AWS Activate
what: AWS credits for early-stage startups, usable on its AI services.

name: Microsoft for Startups
what: Azure credits and support for startups building on Microsoft's cloud and AI.

name: NVIDIA Inception
what: A free programme for AI startups: training, partner offers and cloud credits.

name: Hugging Face courses
what: Free courses on LLMs and agents, built on open tools, with no ads.

name: DeepLearning.AI short courses
what: Short, practical AI courses you can enroll in for free. Certificates need their paid PRO plan.

name: Practical Deep Learning
what: The classic free course that has you training real models from the first lesson.

name: Kaggle Learn and notebooks
what: Free micro-courses, and notebooks with a weekly free GPU quota, usually 30 hours.
